about: prototype-concepts.md (LIN-3187): each concept from John's public prototype repos, the levers it serves, and the strength of the evidence the prototype itself produced for each, coded by the paper's author from the sources cited at the pinned commits. Strength: 0 idea only, no evidence; 1 recorded observation or anecdote, no control; 2 controlled comparison with single runs or an internal or soft endpoint; 3 controlled comparison, repeated, with a stated endpoint. null: the concept does not serve the lever. The strength is of the prototype's own endpoint, not of an effect inside Harbour.

concepts.concept: Short pointer handed to the next session
concepts.evidence: One implementation task: 3 runs with a 93-token file-and-function pointer, median 18 turns and $0.357, against 1 run without, 51 turns and $0.783; same 43-check verifier. Hindsight supplied the pointer.

concepts.concept: Pre-built code map queried instead of exploring
concepts.evidence: 15 tasks, one run each: map-based answers 236/300 rubric points against 286/300 for direct exploration; 0 wins, 14 losses, 1 tie. The judge treats the exploration answer as ground truth.
One run, three checkpoints: pages 30, 53, 62; quality 59.57, 58.11, 58.00; fully accurate answers 6/15, 3/15, 4/15. No comparator.

concepts.concept: Wiki built from commit history, read by a context agent
concepts.evidence: Construction only: 50 commits to 132 pages in about 37 minutes, cost recorded as $0.0000 (a tracking failure); quality self-rated; the context agent's benefit to a caller never measured.

concepts.concept: Durable task record lets stateless calls resume
concepts.evidence: Three closed episodes rebuilt by stateless readers; the records also show 4 repeated passing verifications and 1 conclusion on empty output. A planner given the record re-proposed done work for 24 of 47 nodes, against 4 of 14 without it (different commit, 3 graphs).

concepts.concept: Graph state, a fresh worker per bounded step, code schedules
concepts.evidence: One self-development run: 7 generations, 8 revisions, 1 human step; a different fresh worker rebuilt progress from the graph. Every live model dispatch failed for infrastructure reasons. No comparator, no token counts.

concepts.concept: Investigation structured as a graph, not one tool loop
concepts.evidence: 18 graph-against-tool-loop comparisons, one run each, keyword topic coverage: the graph found more in 14, tied 1, fewer 3, often at 2–5 times the tokens. Selection, sequencing and stopping change together.

concepts.concept: Code holds the plan; the model makes one narrow call a step
concepts.evidence: A cheap small model, 20 trials an arm: a chain driver took a two-hop task from 3/20 to 19/20, then 20/20; a tool that resolves the title in code took URL tasks from 29/40 to 39/40. Development before-and-after, tuned on the same model.

concepts.concept: Lean budgeted research: research, review against sources, release
concepts.evidence: 13 studies in five days with their spend recorded at list rates: median $16.10, $14.03 before the reader review was added and $52.42 after. A stated $20 subagent bound, exceeded three times. No comparator process.

concepts.concept: Staged review: evidence, then a reader's inference, then a recheck
concepts.evidence: LH016 coded 66 public-claim changes over six rounds by the step that made them; three fresh replayed reader reviews on released pieces found 5 of 16 known answers, 7 in part, 4 missed. The coder and reviewers share the model family.

concepts.concept: Fixture eval per workflow step, to pick the cheapest adequate tier
concepts.evidence: 16 Harbour step fixtures, three cheap models, one run each: 14, 13 and 11 of 16 passed; one model scored 7–14 of 16 across harness revisions. Keyword scoring; review and research failed for every model.

concepts.concept: User interventions as labels for where steering is needed
concepts.evidence: 182 sessions, 12.1 interventions each on average; the area classifier was broken when measured and the predictor was never validated.

concepts.concept: Rule detectors for reading spirals and loops in session logs
concepts.evidence: Hand-set thresholds (more than 10 reads with fewer than 3 edits); no tests or evaluation.

concepts.concept: Fixed phase pipeline and a code-built repo scan
concepts.evidence: Code only; no evaluation in the public repository.
